meta.title: The Negotiation
meta.description: A gang member tries to intimidate someone but things don't go as planned

script.line: Alright business man. Hand over your wallet. Nice and slow.
Oh my god! Is that... is that a gun?
Yeah that's right. Now you know I mean business.
Dude that's so cool! Can I hold it?
Is it a nine millimeter? My brother-in-law has one just like it. Where'd you get it?
I STOLE it! Because I'm a CRIMINAL! Give me your WALLET!
Oh... I actually don't have my wallet. I use Apple Pay for everything now.
Nah that leaves a paper trail. My parole officer checks that.
Ooh! There's an ATM two blocks over. I could get cash and we could try this again?
You know what? That's real considerate of you man.
